parameters.description:
`msg-to-pagertree` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your PagerTree destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own PagerTree destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional PagerTree destinations bound per enrollment.

In your PagerTree account, create a webhook integration and point it at the team you want alerted (PagerTree's setup wizard walks you through this). Open that integration's page and copy its Prefix ID (shown at the top, formatted like int_xxxxxxxxxx) — set it as PAGERTREE_TOKEN.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment PagerTree destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your PagerTree integration endpoint
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own PagerTree destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

integration_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PagerTree integration token
